description: Energy manager (demand controller) that reads the utility meter's serial user output (SSU) and drives four control outputs, with Modbus RTU
source: Analo Sistemas de Energia, "Gerenciador de Energia – Tabela de registradores Modbus", revision 2012.04.02

sources.title: Gerenciador de Energia – Tabela de registradores Modbus
sources.note: register table, register formats and mass memory description

notes: Analo Gerenciador de Energia. The registers of the manufacturer's Modbus table, translated to English.

Addresses are the 'Endereço' column of the table (the 'Registrador' column is one higher). Values are 16-bit; several registers pack two bytes, described as high byte / low byte. Values split in LSB and MSB registers are read here as 32-bit, low word first.
The Analo signature registers spell "ANALO" and the hardware model has a fixed value: both are given as references to recognise the device.
The table gives no units or scaling for the counters and SSU values: they are the raw values of the meter's serial user output and of the pulse inputs.

The 128 user registers (128-255) and the four output setting blocks (256-1279, 256 registers each) are not in this map, nor the mass memory (from 1408; records of 4 registers, newest first, described in the table).
